# ADO205: parameter-value-invalid

A parameter value doesn't match the declared type or allowed values.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Templates and parameters |
| **Default severity** | error |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | template expansion |

## Description

Values passed to typed template parameters must match the declared type (boolean, number, string, stepList, ...) and, when values is set, be one of the allowed values.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
parameters:
  runTests: maybe # declared type: boolean
```

Instead:

```yaml
parameters:
  runTests: true
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO205: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO205` or `--enable ADO205`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO205
```
